entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer that supports multi-level memory for users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption. This official provider demonstrates significant task-completion gains and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It builds graphs from text, code, and session data, supporting distillation and retrieval across various LLM providers and Python versions.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed entity relationships and provide synthesized answers with citations. It is designed for institutional memory, offering scoped data access and explicit gap analysis for multi-user environments.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and forgetting while offering connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a learnable memory workflow focused on retain, recall, and reflect operations. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, offering SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based library that enables stateful agents by extracting conclusions from conversation history for reasoning-first memory. It serves as the upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper and supports both local and managed execution.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory like a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency system that operates locally using a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond memory access. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports the Model Context Protocol for tools like Cursor.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context during recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated data in the filesystem to help agents learn from complex tasks. It supports Python and TypeScript extensions and integrates with MCP clients to retain useful lessons across iterations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agent using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to recover specific details from the message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from 25 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over months of past data. It processes up to 5 GB of history while automatically redacting keys and tokens during the indexing phase.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted memory backend that enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process. It achieves 97.6% average LongMemEval accuracy and supports real-time ingestion from platforms like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML files to ensure local ownership. It utilizes hybrid BM25 and embedding search for local-first retrieval across various MCP tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and vector search, integrating directly via MCP and agent hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes LLM inference by reordering blocks and deduplicating content to maximize prefix reuse. This approach reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens within the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It performs context recall using hybrid BM25 and semantic vector search powered by local embedding models.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs in real-time. It utilizes local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models, functioning as an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files before the context window opens. This layer provides local-first persistence and session tracking while reducing prompt tokens by up to 94%.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory for agents using semantic search, BM25 full-text, and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using plain Markdown files. It features a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chats to maintain context across different agent platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with built-in 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting real, immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all memory operations. It addresses specific community issues using an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chains including EVM, Solana, and TON. It allows APIs to charge for access and agents to pay for services directly into wallets with 0% fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing to connect queries with skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It includes tools for knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal, automatically generating routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It features a local SQLite reliability layer with a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin facilitates self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports manual memory storage and retrieval enhanced by configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin enables private local code memory for repositories, offering deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing files. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and provides LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filtering and MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown memory managed through five specialized slash commands for capture and recall. It functions as a curation layer that identifies stale or conflicting data using 'rot' and 'lint' curators to propose evidence-cited updates.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework utilizes a subagent-driven development process to execute tasks autonomously while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs to support software development methodologies.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that generates web, mobile, and desktop prototypes with sandboxed previews and exports to formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4. It supports 26 local CLI executables, including Hermes and DeepSeek Harness.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library contains 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. The skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms for comprehensive security task coverage.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while synchronizing updates to preserve manual layout adjustments. It enforces architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test approach.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw, offering rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state directly within the project's documentation directory.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection provides 1,169 skills for professional and life tasks distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and transcript extraction for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports playlist extraction for media-related workflows.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It enables secure agent operations through sandboxed execution of untrusted scripts and tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models and offers Lite or Full modes to match project complexity.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This tool implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for supervised agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and Markdown-based recipes. It utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first session storage to facilitate structured memory and cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It provides a specialized pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project allows agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integrations for CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams via the Vercel open skills ecosystem.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository provides Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and integrations specifically in Portuguese. All contributions follow the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models into agent workflows via the BFL API. The project includes a specialized router to direct requests to dedicated video generation agents.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This forge converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant agent skills with instructions pinned to specific file lines. It offers lifecycle tooling for managing version-pinned exports and skill dependencies.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io acts as a registry for reusable AI skills, providing a Python client and CLI for installation. It uniquely supports recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery from failures.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika introduces an 'Intent as Code' workflow language for AI that operates through a Rust-based CLI using four core verbs. It is a local-first solution that supports model processing via OpenAI API and Codex access.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This project serves as a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills via a full implementation of the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a five-layer retrieval system—including hard triggers and semantic embeddings—to narrow skill lists before LLM calls, effectively reducing token usage. It is designed for resilience, offering graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: A personal execution OS designed for ADHD support that utilizes an MCP connection for agent-driven scheduling and system design. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages via langid integration and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only code review skill that employs three parallel subagents to conduct adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three parallel agents—Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness—to simplify code across five programming languages. It manages code changes through a risk-tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for multi-story task decomposition and evidence-based verification gates to ensure grounded agent actions. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 industry frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address real-world CVEs ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift and scaffolding new skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demos by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It manages the full lifecycle of visual documentation, including rendering, optimizing GIFs to under 8 MB, and embedding them directly into README markdown.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through a validator that detects frontmatter drift. It ensures long-term compatibility by monitoring official specifications and providing CI-friendly exit codes for skill validation.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework enables self-improvement for agents by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It secures the evolution process by gating all updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability across 11 monitoring tabs, covering token costs, session health, and error tracking. It maintains a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry, offering optional incident alerts for Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project provides a CLI and MCP server to search a massive directory of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It streamlines tool discovery by providing direct installation commands for plugins compatible with Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic file path routing and interpreter selection across diverse Windows environments, including Git Bash, MSYS, and WSL. The tool ensures environment-specific syntax is used while verifying existing project-compatible Python runtimes.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard, allowing agents to handle paid resource requests autonomously.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the reliability of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes a complete toolset for listing bounties, buying context, and managing decentralized bounty boards.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This MCP server exposes 191 tools and five production-grade skills for extracting structured web data across 31 different platforms. It facilitates complex data workflows for agents like Hermes, Cursor, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and produces structured summaries containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for Chinese-language tasks, including Douyin video transcription and a rule-based engine to remove AI-style phrasing from text. It also features document OCR for extracting fields from invoices and contracts.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It automatically updates indexes on file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code symbols and callers.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, via a Terminal User Interface. It allows users to visualize their consumption data and optionally submit it to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported trace sessions to facilitate debugging.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by tool, model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better UIs with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-developed themes and CLI skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using a YAML-based configuration system.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel that operates without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging using human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for workflow management. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo function for recent agent-driven changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory adapters for platforms like Slack and VS Code to support frameworks such as the Claude Agent SDK. It utilizes a two-tier system consisting of knowledge graphs and session caches.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings for Hermes Agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services at zero cost. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that performs local, deterministic checks to flag overlapping tool descriptions and missing termination conditions. It supports CI integration through SARIF exports and provides HERM v1.1 scoring without external API calls.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures for the new environment.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides real-time telemetry for Hermes agent conversations through a native plugin without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for external actions and exposes its functionality through dynamic slash commands.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for agent data. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and features a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for configuring Hermes Agent alongside other CLIs like Claude Code and Gemini. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one administrative tool for multiple agent environments.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities. It includes 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks and supports remote access through WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web-based interface is built using Python and vanilla JavaScript to enable Hermes Agent access from browsers and mobile devices without a build step. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial experience with Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single application.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes-studio is a web dashboard that features a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and loops for complex task automation. It manages local sessions via a self-built SQLite database and integrates with messaging channels including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a memory browser for deep agent inspection. It uniquely offers a Swarm Mode that utilizes role-based dispatching and tmux-backed workers for coordinated agent activity.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, into a single interface. It supports desktop, Docker, and native mobile clients, and allows users to register any ACP-compatible agent.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It features native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs directly from the desktop.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri and Rust, featuring a specialized Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check and update capabilities. It provides native window management and a UI capable of rendering LaTeX and Markdown for technical interactions.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension bridges active browser context with local or remote Hermes runtimes for site-aware drafting and tab management. It includes a Bot Mode for multi-agent switching and collaborative threading within the browser interface.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive self-hosted Hermes agents directly from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to provide real-time chat, task management, and workspace file browsing without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based consciousness monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view specifically designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health via kanban pipelines. It functions as an MCP server control plane that supports real-time chat with streaming and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that indexes local agent transcripts across 14 formats, including Claude Code and Cursor, without uploading data. It serves as an analytics cockpit that tracks per-session burn against five-hour and weekly quota windows.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing agent sessions alongside a kanban board for task management. Users can manage profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets within a unified terminal environment.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and secures Telegram validation via dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring Docker or admin rights. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting both local models via LM Studio and cloud models via OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It integrates a file browser with management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on session activity and cost tracking with full inspection capabilities for conversation histories and skill source code. It provides read-only access to configuration settings and environment variables for process oversight.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure execution. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching during streaming chat sessions.
